purpose: Evaluate Omnigent as the shared API and meta-harness layer for CREATE SOMETHING agents without granting it authority over A4 execution.

authority.authoritySource: CREATE SOMETHING repo policy plus Linear approval packet

a4ExecutionCommand.blockedUntil: authority.a4Execution is changed by repo policy and an executor implementation revalidates the command receipt immediately before any write

a4ExecutorProof.blockedUntil: operator-approved repo policy change enables a narrowly scoped executor implementation with rollback and smoke proof

a4ExecutorEnablementProposal.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed PR applies the proposed policy patch and reruns access, rollback, and smoke proof

a4PolicyPatchDryRun.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed PR applies the validated patch and reruns public access, rollback, and smoke proof

a4PolicyApplicationDiff.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed policy application PR uses this verifier against its candidate manifest before enabling any runner path

a4EnabledManifestReadiness.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed implementation PR adds a runner that revalidates the full chain immediately before any write

a4RunnerImplementationContract.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed implementation PR can add runner code only after checked-in policy is enabled and the runner revalidates the full chain immediately before any write

a4RunnerImplementationPlan.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed implementation PR adds the planned runner entrypoint only after checked-in policy is enabled and the full plan is revalidated

a4RunnerImplementationDiff.blockedUntil: a separate operator-reviewed implementation PR may add only the exact planned runner entrypoint after checked-in policy is enabled and this diff is revalidated

a4ReleaseAdmission.blockedUntil: operator-reviewed release admission may merge only after policy and runner PR evidence, full receipt revalidation, rollback note, and public access fail-closed proof are present

a4ExecutionRunbook.blockedUntil: operator-reviewed execution runbook may be used only after release admission receipt, checked-in enabled policy, exact command receipt, target validation, rollback readiness, post-action smoke, and public fail-closed proof are present

a4ReceiptBundle.blockedUntil: operator-reviewed receipt bundle may be shared only after the full receipt chain, redaction policy, public fail-closed proof, and no-execution markers validate without exposing secrets, raw logs, or prompts

a4ReceiptPublication.blockedUntil: operator-reviewed receipt publication packets may describe where a redacted bundle should be shared, but this verifier must not post to Linear, write a signed record, expose raw artifacts, enable execution, or mutate third-party systems

a4ReceiptReviewDecision.blockedUntil: operator receipt-review decisions may approve, request changes, reject, or block a future manual next step, but this verifier must not enable execution, post updates, spawn a runner, or mutate third-party systems

a4FollowUpWorkIntake.blockedUntil: follow-up work intake packets may describe the next implementation scope, but this verifier must not claim issues, create worktrees, create branches, open PRs, enable execution, spawn a runner, expose raw artifacts, or mutate third-party systems

a4ImplementationWorkspaceEvidence.blockedUntil: implementation workspace evidence packets may prove an operator prepared a scoped workspace, but this verifier must not claim issues, create worktrees, create branches, open PRs, enable execution, spawn a runner, expose raw artifacts, or mutate third-party systems

a4ImplementationMergeDecision.blockedUntil: implementation merge decision packets may approve, hold, or request changes for manual follow-up, but this verifier must not mark PRs ready, merge, deploy, enable execution, spawn a runner, expose raw artifacts, or mutate third-party systems

promotionGates.required: manifest passes deterministic validator
one Omnigent-wrapped read-only scout session or dry-run fixture produces a receipt mirrored to Linear
Omnigent session receipt fields match local harness receipt fields for signal, context, policy, action, validation, rollback, and next decision
A4 approval packet validates before any high-risk action is exposed
A4 preflight receipt emits the exact dry-run execution, validation, smoke, and rollback plan without executing writes
A4 execution receipt schema validates the packet and preflight receipt while keeping execution disabled
A4 execution authorization artifact validates the packet, preflight receipt, and disabled execution receipt while keeping execution disabled
A4 execution command artifact validates the full authorization chain while keeping the runner disabled and execution blocked
A4 disabled executor proof validates the full command receipt chain and proves the runner stops before process spawn
A4 executor enablement proposal validates the future policy patch and proof requirements without applying the policy change
A4 policy patch dry run validates the proposal receipt and exact patch preview without changing the manifest or enabling the runner
A4 policy application diff validates a candidate manifest against the dry-run receipt without changing the checked-in manifest in the verifier PR
A4 enabled-manifest readiness validates the candidate enabled manifest and application diff receipt without spawning a runner or changing checked-in policy
A4 runner implementation contract validates the future runner obligations against the full readiness chain without spawning a runner or changing checked-in policy
A4 runner implementation plan validates the future entrypoint, guards, revalidation sequence, proof plans, and receipt outputs without adding or running an executable runner
A4 runner implementation diff validates the exact candidate entrypoint, guard surface, proof hooks, receipt outputs, and file additions without adding or running the executable runner

A4 release admission validates policy PR evidence, runner PR evidence, merge order, rollback note, public fail-closed proof, and full receipt revalidation before promotion while still performing no execution

A4 execution runbook validates target validation, write command, post-action smoke, rollback command, public fail-closed proof, final receipt outputs, and stop conditions against the release admission receipt without executing
A4 receipt bundle validates a shareable redacted receipt set for asynchronous operator review against the execution runbook receipt without exposing secrets, raw logs, prompts, or executing
A4 receipt publication validates where and how a redacted receipt bundle may be shared for asynchronous operator review without posting, exposing raw artifacts, or executing
A4 receipt review decision validates the operator review outcome for the published receipt packet without enabling execution, posting updates, or mutating production

A4 implementation post-merge validation validates operator-provided post-merge checks and smoke evidence without deploying, exposing raw artifacts, or executing
